script: Okay, let's talk about the message gap. In a Pew survey of online daters, sixty-four percent of men said they felt insecure about getting too few messages. That's men of all ages, not just over forty. But if your phone is quiet, here are three fixes. One: make your first message specific. Mention one thing from her profile, and ask one easy question. Two: update your photos. One clear, smiling photo beats five blurry ones. Three: after a few good messages, suggest a coffee in a public place, with a day and a time. And if she doesn't reply, that's fine. Don't chase. Just move on. If you want fifty texts you can copy, comment TEXTS, and I'll send you my free cheat sheet.
